Complūtum , i. n.,
I.a town of the Carpetani in Hispania Tarraconensis, now Alcala de Henarez, Prud. στεφ. 4, 43.—Hence, adj.: Complūtensis , e, of or belonging to Complutum, Complutensian: “ager,” Paul. Nol. Carm. 32, 605 .—As subst.: Complūtenses , ium, m., the people of Complutum, Plin. 3, 3, 4, § 24.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
